mode: Built-in image_gen for raster generation and edits; no API/CLI fallback. SVGs authored as editable vector redraws.

assets.note: Chosen from four candidate directions (frames, ribbon, stack, avatar); the stack was generated twice and the second result kept.
assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: primary logo concept for VVV (Vibe, Vision, Video), reusable video templates for coding agents.
Primary request: three complete, identical, bold V letters (each clearly a full V with two arms meeting at a sharp bottom point and a flat top) arranged in a row, overlapping slightly so each V's right arm passes in front of the next V's left arm, like three copies of one template laid down in sequence. Overlaps are separated by a thin knock-out gap of negative space, flat, no shading. The two left Vs are ink black #111111, the rightmost V is signal yellow-green #DFFF00. Every V must be fully readable as the letter V.
Style: Swiss editorial identity, flat vector-like, crisp edges.
Composition: one centered mark, wider than tall, about 60% of canvas width, generous empty space all around. Isolated on a fully transparent background.
Text: no text, only the three V letters.
Constraints: exactly THREE complete V letterforms, no gradients, no shadow, no glow, no 3D, no border, no watermark.

assets.method: Geometric redraw in build-logo.py: V 500 x 406 units, top arm width 148, step 352, knock-out gap 11; each V is clipped beyond the previous V's right outer edge plus the gap.
4x-supersampled Pillow render of the same polygons (build-logo.py)

assets.note: Chosen from four new concepts (signal poster, relay, press, echo).

steps.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: wide 2:1 README hero for an open-source developer project.
Input images: Image 1 is the logo: three identical V letters laid down left to right, each tucked behind the previous one with a thin gap. Reproduce its exact geometry once, small, as the brand mark; do not redraw or restyle it.
Primary request: the logo's V form becomes architecture. Many identical large V-shaped slabs stand in a long row receding into depth like frames in a film reel or pages of a flipbook, each slab a thin sheet of matte off-white material, all exactly the same shape; the nearest slab is solid signal yellow-green #DFFF00. Soft studio light rakes across them, casting long clean shadows on a dark floor.
Scene/backdrop: ink #111111 studio void with a faint horizon.
Composition: the receding row of slabs occupies the right 60%, vanishing toward the upper right; logo, headline and small line on the left; footer bottom-left.
Style/medium: minimalist architectural 3D render, sculptural, quiet, premium.
Color palette: ink #111111, paper #F5F3E8, accent #DFFF00.
Text (verbatim, crisp, correctly spelled, nothing else anywhere):
- headline, two lines: "Build a template once." / "Reuse it across agents."
- one small line: "Open-source video templates for coding agents"
- small letter-spaced footer: "CLAUDE CODE · CODEX"
Constraints: no people, no watermark, no extra logos.

steps.method: The generated mark (box 102,195-383,290) covered with the background above it, then the vector logo-light geometry placed in the same box.
"VIBEVISION.VIDEO" set above the footer in Inter 500 (kit font, OFL), 15 px caps, 0.24 em tracking, #DFFF00.
